QuestInfo.name: Keeny's Spring Flower Research 3
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World. You hear that #bKeeny in Magatia#k is researching spring flowers but Keeny needs your help. Let's go to meet Keeny!
QuestInfo.1: Let's help with the research to plant far more spring flowers!
QuestInfo.2: You successfully helped with the Spring Flower Research and finally, far more spring flowers bloom in Maple World.
QuestInfo.summary: Give 3 Clovers to Keeny in Magatia.

0.0: Did you know that we are researching spring flowers for planting? We want far more of them in the Maple World! Your flowers will be a great help to our research.

yes.0: It will be a great help to the research on spring flowers in Maple World if you can deliver #b3 Clovers#k to #bKeeny in Magatia#k.  Hope you can do this now.

1.0: Oh...? Are these Clovers? Did you hear that Keeny is researching spring flowers?

yes.0: Finally, you brought me some Clovers! I am glad that I can do my best on the research for spring flowers! Thank you so much!
yes.1: Clovers mean 'luck'. I wish you have always good luck in Maple World. I will give you a #bClover Sticker#k!

npc.0: Why didn't you go to Keeny quickly? You have to go to Magatia and give her #b3 Clovers#k.
